messages:
mira: Quick internal heads-up: were GAing the Streaming Gateway today. New single endpoint: POST /v1/stream-unified. It combines streaming, tool-calls, and structured outputs. Docs + short migration notes live at https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-unified-ga — please skim if you touch SDKs or customer docs.

tom: Nice. Any new model defaults?

mira: Ship includes mosaic-mini-q (aggressively quantized, tuned for high concurrency). Theres an automatic fallback to mosaic-standard for quality regressions. New orgs get it on by default; existing orgs have a 12-day opt-in in Console.

kevin: Ops note: DM me for canary keys if you need to validate at scale. Alerting updated under "stream-unified" service; logs: https://internal-logs/stream-unified/1847000000.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout progress: canary 0% -> 70% across regions, no crash alerts. Small transient 502s handled by retries during early canary.

anya: Any breaking request shape changes?

mira: Minimal. Top-level envelope now accepts {"model","stream","tools","structured_out","input"}. Backwards compatibility kept for 12 days; SDK patches will be published to add helpers. Example curl:
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-unified \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-mini-q","stream":true,"tools":true,"input":"extract bullets"}'
```

kevin: Also note a new per-route cost estimate in Console so teams can see token delta before switching.

mira: TL;DR: Streaming Gateway (stream-unified) GA, mosaic-mini-q available, 12-day opt-in then staged auto-migrations, canary keys from @kevin, fallback routing in place. Ping me for migration issues. :tada:
